summary: Phase 3F F2 (Customers segment on the v3 engine) tested against the public preview URL. Everything was read-only and no saved views were created. Backend: new public suite test_reports_v3_f2.py passes 29/29, and probe scripts checked the numbers further. Customer statement: the last balance of every booking equals bills − received − waived for all 82 customers (0 mismatches), and waiver and waiver-cancelled lines look right. Ageing: the 5 bands add up to Total due on every row and in the totals. Advance holders only lists rows with advance > 0. Call list sorts by days overdue, oldest first; Overdue + Due soon add up to all rows. KYC pending and include-complete filters work. Payment behaviour has one row per customer and row clicks open /customers/{id}. The directory has 82 rows, matching the Customers list. Cancelled rows satisfy refund paid + pending = payable; transferred rows show from → to. Exports, grouping, sorting, 422 validation, sales 403 (report and export) and accounts 200 all work. Frontend: the hub shows 10 Customers tiles, and service-sla opens /reports/service-sla. The statement shows the 'Pick a customer…' message, and picking a customer through rf-customer works. The table shows −₹ balances and As-of narrows the lines (49 → 13). On all 7 other reports, the breadcrumb shows the title and group by, the column chooser, header sort and the Excel download work. Project → tower cascade, Why call, Next due presets, Pending, Include complete and Behaviour filters work. Share link reproduces the view. At 390px the page shows cards and 'Filters · N'. Night theme is readable. 0 page errors. Main finding: the hub headlines for 3 tiles show the wrong figure.

minor.issue: The headline is the first money key in spec['totals'], not the report's main figure. Customer-ageing shows '₹2,38,59,162 · not due' instead of Total due ₹4,49,76,643. Advance-holders shows '₹1,98,38,965 · bills raised' instead of Advance held ₹7,36,226. Payment-behaviour shows '₹34,09,91,433 · received', from a column hidden by default; on-time % would fit better. Fix: add an explicit 'headline' key per spec (total_due, advance_total, on-time %) and use it in hub tile().
The formula prints a negative balance in brackets: 'balance (₹2,42,810)' for Usha Thakur. The table cells correctly show −₹2,42,810. Use the same −₹ form in the formula, PDF and Excel headers.

With dir=desc, rows with None values come first. Example: customer-ageing sort=last_payment&dir=desc gives None, None, then 2026-11-18. The (is None, value) key is reversed together with the value. Blanks should stay last in both directions.

A customer whose bills are raised but not yet due is labelled 'No bills yet'. Example: Rohit Agarwal, ₹42.57L billed. Suggested label: 'Nothing due yet'. Also, the bill_settle_days docstring says 'bills due by as_of', but a bill paid before its due date (still in the future) is counted as on time, so 'Σ bills due' slightly overstates the tieout wording.

Last and next follow-up are '—' on all 42 rows. The code is right: it reads the booking's lead follow_ups, but every converted lead in the demo has follow_ups=[] and next_follow_up_at=None. The columns can't be seen working in the demo, so consider adding collection follow-ups to the story data.

ui_bugs.issue: Group header and Grand total rows leave On time % and Avg days late blank. These could be computed from on_time/bills_due and late days.

issues: The 'Next due' date presets only look backwards (Today, Yesterday, This/Last week, month, quarter). A call list needs forward windows such as Next 7 days or Next 30 days.
For overdue rows, 'Next due' shows the oldest unpaid due date (e.g. 28 Jun 2025), which reads oddly under the label 'Next due'.
Band headers are inconsistent: '0–30 days' next to '31–60', '61–90', '90+'.
The Total row leaves the Balance cell blank. It could show the closing balance (with −₹ when negative).

action_items: Hub: add a per-report headline key (ageing → total_due, advance-holders → advance_total, payment-behaviour → on-time %) instead of the first money total.
Statement formula: show negative balances as −₹… to match the table.
engine.sort_rows: keep None and blank values last when sorting descending.
Call list: add forward-looking Next due presets (Next 7 days, Next 30 days, This month remaining).
Optional: rename 'No bills yet' to 'Nothing due yet'; compute on-time % and avg days late on group rows; add collection follow-ups to the demo story.
critical_code_review_comments: customers2.cancelled projects refunds.amount_total_paise but only sums amount_paise. If a refund doc stores only amount_total_paise, the paid amount will be 0. Currently ties out (₹4,22,892 paid).
customers2.directory runs an unscoped db.users.find({}) on every call; the same happens in cancelled(). Fine at demo scale.
Statement 'waived' line uses `e.get('jama_paise') or 0 if waiver else 0`. It is correct due to precedence but hard to read; add parentheses.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; hub headline choice and minor design items)

seed_data_creation: None. No saved views were created and no data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: F2 public suite: cd /app/tests/phase3f_public && python -m pytest test_reports_v3_f2.py -o addopts='' -q. The in-repo backend suite (backend/tests/test_phase3f_engine.py, private :8021 snapshot) was NOT rerun by me. Data as of 18 Nov 2026: 42 ageing/call-list rows, 5 advance holders (Usha Thakur has a negative balance of −₹2,42,810), 80 KYC rows (all agreements signed, 2 KYC pending), 82 directory customers, 5 cancelled/transferred cases. Waiver test customer: Jyoti Sinha (waiver + waiver cancelled).
